issues.notes: colonizePlanet(planetId, empireId) is never called — all dispatches go directly via store.dispatch({type: 'COLONIZE_PLANET', payload: {planetId, fleetId}}). The action creator signature doesn't match the reducer's expected payload (fleetId vs empireId). Should either wire the action creator properly or remove it.

verification_result.notes: Colonization UI fully implemented and verified. All 6 acceptance criteria met. Game logic (systems/colonization.ts) is sound: canColonize validates fleet position, ownership, habitability, colony component, and hostile env tech. colonize() correctly consumes ship, initializes colony, and updates all registries. InfoPanel correctly shows COLONIZE button when colony ship fleet exists at system. PlanetScreen correctly manages the new colony with sliders. Note: InfoPanel doesn't pre-check hostile env tech before showing colonize button (only checks fleet + colonizable target), but the colonize action properly validates this in the reducer. All 108 tests pass, typecheck clean. Minor dead code in actions/colony.ts: colonizePlanet action creator unused.

worker_output.summary: Colonization flow UI complete. Implementation spans: GalaxyScreen (screen container), InfoPanel (Colonize button in uncolonized panel), PlanetScreen (planet management), systems/colonization.ts (pure game logic), actions/colony.ts (action creators). All 6 acceptance criteria verified: (1) colony ship fleet at system shows COLONIZE button, 'Requires: Colony Ship' when absent; (2) button triggers COLONIZE_PLANET action; (3) new planet set with empire ownerId and isColonized=true, renders with empire-colored ring on star map; (4) reducer navigates to planet screen with selectedPlanet set; (5) colony ship consumed via removeColonyShip from fleet and ships registry, fleet dissolved if empty; (6) canColonize validates hasColonizationTech for hostile envs, rejects without required Controlled [Environment] tech.
